title: Support for Teachers with Young Children and Those Returning to Work after Extended Absence
what_it_is: Support for Teachers with Young Children and Those Returning to Work after Extended Absence

sections.label: Flexible work arrangements for teachers
sections.summary: MOE offers teachers flexible work arrangements including part-time work, and does not collect data on these localised arrangements.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: The Ministry of Education (MOE) provides a range of options for teachers who require flexible work arrangements (FWAs), including to meet medical needs or caregiving responsibilities.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: These include part-time work arrangements for teachers who require a reduced workload.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: Teachers who need more flexible work hours, such as a later reporting time to send their young children to a childcare centre, should discuss their needs with their schools early so that arrangements can be made to support them, where operationally feasible.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: As many of these FWAs are localised and could be on an ad hoc or short-term basis, MOE does not collect such data.

sections.label: Childcare arrangements near schools
sections.summary: A Member asks if MOE would work with agencies like ECDA to facilitate childcare arrangements near schools for teacher-parents.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng (Jurong)
sentences.text: Can I ask the Minister of State if MOE would consider working with agencies, such as the Early Childhood Development Agency (ECDA) to help facilitate childcare arrangements for such young teacher-parents, childcare arrangements as near to the school, place of work, as possible to help these teachers continue as fully as possible at work while maintaining their responsibilities to their own children at home as well?

sections.label: Adjunct teachers and childcare options
sections.summary: Schools hire flexible adjunct teachers, and MOE is open to exploring options while respecting parents' childcare preferences.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: For example, there are some schools that hire flexible adjunct teachers to cover the duties of the main teachers for certain periods of time so that our teachers who have other urgent needs or caregiving needs, will also be able to continue with their teaching careers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: On the Member's suggestion to have arrangements with other agencies, I believe he mentioned ECDA.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: We are open to exploring all options, but at the same time, we also respect that parents usually have their own preferences on childcare arrangements; it is not just about whether the childcare centre is near their homes, but sometimes, parents themselves have other considerations on the choice of childcare.
